_readme: Small config the agent reads/writes each run. artifactUrl is filled in after the first successful publish and must be reused (not regenerated) on every subsequent run so updates land on the same page instead of creating a new one each day.
pagesPublishScope: every run — uses GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN if set (scheduled cloud runs), else the local gh CLI
lastRunStatus: Weekly research run: 2 new evidence rows admitted (Gartner CHRO role-redesign survey, MIT CISR minimum-viable-governance research). job-architecture-shifts-skills-based-not-role-based moved 2→3 (first independent corroboration, resolving its single-source COI caveat). One red-team score downgrade: ai-bifurcates-it-staffing-support-contracts-infra-grows 5→4 (Gartner customer-service-leader survey — only 20% report AI-driven headcount reduction — contradicts the frontline-contraction mechanism from an adjacent population). agentic-ai-governance-outpaces-readiness gained its first academic-tier (MIT CISR) corroboration, no score change (already capped). Two oversized summaries (agentic-ai-governance-outpaces-readiness, ai-compresses-engineering-team-size-junior-pipeline) were rewritten back under the 4-paragraph cap, and a prose 'see also' cross-reference was removed in favor of the existing structured relatedTo edge. Product Management, QA/Test Engineering, Data Engineering, and Help Desk/IT Support searched per the coverage mandate; a strong McKinsey product-management study was found but discarded as outside the 12-month recency window (published 2024-05-31) — no qualifying founding evidence for any of the four gap roles this run.
pagesTokenPermissions: fine-grained PAT, repository access limited to sdm1130/ai-it-research-tracker, Contents: Read and write (Metadata: Read-only is added automatically). Nothing else required: main has no branch protection or rulesets, and Pages is build_type=legacy on main:/ so it rebuilds on push.

pagesPublishExitCodes.3: no credentials — skip and report mirror stale
pagesPublishExitCodes.1: real failure e.g. expired token — report loudly
